The one held-name print in the window is KR's company-confirmed 12-03 call, 4 trading days out (11-30, 12-01, 12-02, 12-03). Following L2, I checked every held and listed symbol against its own estimate and filings: there is no 4.01, 4.02 or new 5.02 anywhere, and no crypto, rates or ETF item for an eighth session.
